purpose: SlicerCineTrack is a 3D Slicer extension that enables target tracking visualization by replaying cine 2D images and overlaying ROI outlines using transformation data files.
summary: SlicerCineTrack is a well-implemented 3D Slicer extension for cine target tracking visualization. All catalog entries, CMake configuration, licensing, safety, and Slicer conventions have been verified with no blocking issues or concerns. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Inspected source files for unsafe evaluation, network connections, telemetry, command injection, or unauthorized data transmission. No safety issues found.

environment.rationale: Packages like openpyxl, xlrd, and dcmrtstruct2nii are installed on demand via slicer.util.pip_install only after user confirmation. No core Slicer packages or PyTorch are affected.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and Track/CMakeLists.txt correctly build and install all scripted modules and resources. Catalog entry matches requirements.

license.rationale: The LICENSE.txt file contains a standard BSD 3-Clause variant with clear redistribution and use terms.

soundness.rationale: Follows Slicer ScriptedLoadableModule conventions, handles parameter nodes, validates user inputs, and cleans up properly.

utility.rationale: Well-documented repository with clear installation and usage instructions, tutorials, and disclaimers.

not_checked: Complete dynamic execution of the UI logic and all rendering paths in Slicer GUI environment.
